creation_justification_if_any: No new accessibility ontology, Easy Read system, scientific record, learning architecture, review registry, publication pipeline or evidence store is created. This source-owned manifest binds an already-active accessibility projection to existing EduLinked authority and review mechanisms.

explicit_non_use_decisions.reason: Accessibility representations must remain deterministic projections of the canonical hypothesis object so scientific facts, uncertainty, contradiction, review state and provenance cannot silently diverge.
The current proven route retains Core semantic authority and edulinked-accessibility-system implementation/navigation authority.

explicit_non_use_decisions.asset: New AAC, symbol-supported or Auslan projection
explicit_non_use_decisions.reason: Core supports these projection types, but the inspected public-research source does not yet contain an attributable user, audience or publication requirement authorising a new modality. Re-enter on evidenced need rather than portfolio symmetry.
Current delivery is HTML. Reuse AccessFlow if a document, PDF or Canva derivative is actually selected.

review_gates: Scientific meaning, evidence status, contradictions, uncertainty and clinical_use:false remain controlled by the canonical research object and scientific review lifecycle.
Easy Read semantic preservation and accessibility quality require human review; generated markup alone is insufficient.
Participant or audience comprehension must not be inferred from rendering success or interface validation.
AAC, symbol-supported, Auslan or other alternative modalities require attributable communication-access need and specialist/person review where applicable.
Public research publication authority and accessibility approval remain separate protected decisions.
remaining_gaps: No human Easy Read/accessibility review receipt is established for the generated hypothesis projection.
No participant or audience comprehension evidence is established.
No attributable requirement currently activates AAC, symbol-supported, Auslan, audio, video or other alternate representation for this research surface.
No accessibility-conformance or Easy Read certification claim is established by this binding.
reentry_triggers: Core Easy Read/accessibility semantic authority changes or is superseded.
An attributable audience, participant or publication requirement activates AAC, symbols, Auslan, audio, video or another alternative representation.
A document, PDF or Canva derivative is selected and AccessFlow becomes applicable.
Human accessibility review, participant comprehension evidence or scientific-publication state materially changes.
A downstream worker attempts to create a second accessibility or Easy Read record for the same hypothesis.
